title: China's AI Ecosystem Shines Bright: Ranking First Globally in Call Volume, Star Models Rise to the Top

content_html:
The latest statistics on the global artificial intelligence market have been released, with Chinese AI large models maintaining a strong leading position in terms of call popularity.

According to relevant monitoring data, the total number of calls for global AI large models reached 69 trillion Tokens last week, an increase of 21.48% compared to the previous week. In this global competition for computing power and applications, the weekly call volume of Chinese large models reached 34.25 trillion Tokens, achieving a steady growth of 21.76%. At the same time, the weekly call volume of American large models was 9.17 trillion Tokens. As a result, Chinese large models have continuously exceeded the United States in weekly call volume for fifteen consecutive weeks, firmly holding the top position globally.

In terms of specific model performance, several major domestic products have experienced explosive growth. Among them, the official version of DeepSeek-V4-Flash performed exceptionally well, with a weekly call volume surging to 8.83 trillion Tokens, representing a sharp increase of 570% compared to the previous week, and it quickly took the top position. Following closely behind is Tencent's Hy3 model, which had a weekly call volume of 8.05 trillion Tokens, with a growth rate of 67%.

This series of impressive data not only highlights the high frequency and activity of domestic large models in practical application scenarios, but also confirms that they are continuously gaining widespread market recognition in terms of technological iteration and industrialization.

content_html_zh:
全球人工智能市场最新统计数据出炉，中国AI大模型调用热度保持强势领先地位。

据相关监测数据显示，上周全球AI大模型调用总量达到69万亿Token，较前一周增长21.48%。 在这场全球算力和应用的争夺中，中国大机型周调用量达到34.25万亿Token，实现21.76%的稳定增长。 与此同时，美国大机型每周调用量为 9.17 万亿个 Token。 由此，中国大型模特的周调用量连续十五周超过美国，稳坐全球第一的位置。

从具体车型表现来看，国内几大产品都出现了爆发式增长。 其中，DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版表现异常出色，周调用量飙升至8.83万亿Token，较前一周大幅增长570%，迅速占据榜首位置。 紧随其后的是腾讯的Hy3模型，其每周调用量为8.05万亿个Token，增长率为67%。

这一系列令人印象深刻的数据不仅凸显了国产大型车型在实际应用场景中的高频率和活跃度，也印证了它们在技术迭代和产业化方面正在不断获得市场的广泛认可。
